description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It manages the assignment and removal of keywords to test cases and test suites, including GUI initialization, request parameter parsing, and interaction with database managers for test cases and test suites. The script handles different contexts such as individual test cases and entire test suites, providing functionality for keyword management operations.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Parses request parameters, initializes and returns an object containing arguments for keyword assignment operations, including test case or suite IDs, action flags, user info, and filtering options.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes a GUI state object with permissions and context based on user rights and current operation parameters.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has the right to assign or remove keywords within the project.
